outputs.explanation: This is a spatial tissue image (micrograph) with cluster color-coding overlay, not a plot of averaged data; individual-data-points check does not apply.
H&E micrographs with manual region annotations; not a quantitative plot of averaged values.
Contains H&E micrographs plus spatial expression maps (heatmap-style color coding of Log2 expression per spot). Heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points would not be meaningful/readable.

Bar graph shows log2 fold-change values per gene derived from a differential expression test (Seurat FindMarkers, Wilcoxon rank-sum), each bar annotated with its associated p-value. This represents a single computed test statistic per gene rather than an average across biological replicates, so there are no discrete individual data points to overlay.
